Q1 console error rate (5m bins): ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL | where ContainerAppName_s == "nzila-os-union-eyes-staging" and TimeGenerated > ago(14d) | summarize total=count(), errors=countif(Log_s matches regex @"(?i)\b(error|exception|fatal|unhandled)\b") by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h) | extend error_ratio = todouble(errors)/total | order by TimeGenerated desc | take 5
Q2 auth denials (console): ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL | where ContainerAppName_s == "nzila-os-union-eyes-staging" and TimeGenerated > ago(14d) | where Log_s matches regex @"(?i)(unauthori[sz]ed|forbidden|\b40[13]\b|auth.*(denied|fail))" | summarize denials=count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1d) | order by TimeGenerated desc | take 5
Q3 background job failures: ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL | where ContainerAppName_s == "nzila-os-union-eyes-staging" and TimeGenerated > ago(14d) | where Log_s has_any ("deadline-overdue: failed", "deadline-engine.worker", "cron") and Log_s matches regex @"(?i)(fail|error|dead_letter)" | summarize failures=count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1d) | order by TimeGenerated desc | take 5
Q4 database failures: ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL | where ContainerAppName_s == "nzila-os-union-eyes-staging" and TimeGenerated > ago(14d) | where Log_s matches regex @"(?i)(failed query|permission denied|row-level security|ECONNREFUSED|ETIMEDOUT|deadlock|too many connections|does not exist)" | summarize n=count(), sample=any(substring(Log_s,0,160)) by bin(TimeGenerated, 1d) | order by TimeGenerated desc | take 5
Q5 audit persistence failures: ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL | where ContainerAppName_s == "nzila-os-union-eyes-staging" and TimeGenerated > ago(14d) | where Log_s has "audit" and Log_s matches regex @"(?i)(fail|error|rollback)" | summarize n=count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1d) | order by TimeGenerated desc | take 5
Q6 lease/queue health (worker logs): ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL | where ContainerAppName_s == "nzila-os-union-eyes-staging" and TimeGenerated > ago(14d) | where Log_s has_any ("lease", "reminder.lease_recovered", "dead_letter", "deadline-engine.worker") | summarize n=count(), lastSeen=max(TimeGenerated) by bin(TimeGenerated, 1d) | order by TimeGenerated desc | take 5
Q7 replica health and restarts (system l: ContainerAppSystemLogs_CL | where ContainerAppName_s == "nzila-os-union-eyes-staging" and TimeGenerated > ago(14d) | summarize n=count() by Reason_s | order by n desc | take 10
